title: Kilauea Episode 49 Erupted & Ended June 14 — Record-Breaking 49th Episodic Eruption, 213m Fountains, 5500m Plume
snippet: Kilauea Episode 49 erupted June 14 09:36 HST, ended 17:05 HST after 7.5 hours. Lava fountains reached 213m (700ft), ash/gas plume 5500m (18,000ft). Alert level lowered WATCH→ADVISORY. Record-breaking 49th episodic eruption, exceeding Pu'u'O'o 1983-86 record of 47 episodes. GOES-18 and InSAR monitoring confirmed.
